description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour script for managing AR anchor placement using Vuforia SDK, including handling Vuforia lifecycle events, hit test results, and managing anchor GameObjects.

classes.name: DeployStageOnce
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour for deploying and managing AR anchors within a scene, utilizing Vuforia's PositionalDeviceTracker.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the script, verifies the AnchorStage reference, and initializes internal flags.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Registers the callback to Vuforia start event.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the callback to prevent memory leaks or unwanted callbacks after destruction.

methods.name: OnVuforiaStarted
methods.description: Retrieves the PositionalDeviceTracker instance when Vuforia becomes active.

methods.name: OnInteractiveHitTest
methods.description: Handles AR hit test results to create and position anchors in the scene, managing anchor GameObjects accordingly.
